common.noNotificationsDesc: አሁን ምንም ማሳወቂያ የለዎትም። አዳዲሶች ሲኖሩ እዚህ ይታያሉ።
common.noSearchResultsDesc: ከእርስዎ ፍለጋ ጋር የሚዛመድ ምንም ነገር አላገኘንም። እባክዎ የተለየ ቃል ይሞክሩ።
common.noCoursesDesc: አሁን ምንም ኮርሶች አይገኙም። እባክዎ በኋላ ይመልሱ።
common.enrollProfileRequired: ለመመዝገብ በመጀመሪያ የመገለጫ መረጃዎን ማጠናቀቅ አለብዎት።
common.noModulesDesc: ይህ ኮርስ እስካሁን ምንም ሞዱሎች የሉትም። እባክዎ በኋላ ይመልሱ።
common.courseOverviewDesc: ይህ ኮርስ ስለ ሳይበር ደህንነት አስፈላጊ እውቀትን እና ክህሎቶችን ይሰጣል። ዝርዝር መረጃ ለማግኘት ይመዝገቡ።
common.readyToGetStartedDesc: ዛሬ ይመዝገቡ እና የሳይበር ደህንነት ጉዞዎን ይጀምሩ።
common.noEnrollmentsDesc: እስካሁን በምንም ኮርሶች አልተመዘገቡም። ኮርሶችን ያስሱ እና መማር ይጀምሩ።
common.noRecommendationsDesc: እስካሁን ለእርስዎ ምንም ምክሮች የሉም። ተጨማሪ ኮርሶችን ሲወስዱ ምክሮች ይታያሉ።
common.getInTouchDesc: ስለ ሳይበር ደህንነት ስልጠና ጥያቄዎች አሉዎት? የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ ይፈልጋሉ? ወይስ አጠራጣሪ እንቅስቃሴን ሪፖርት ማድረግ ይፈልጋሉ? ቡድናችን እርስዎን ለማገዝ ዝግጁ ነው።
common.headquartersAddress:
INSA Cyber Security Awareness
Addis Ababa
China Road
common.howCanWeHelpDesc: ስለ ሳይበር ደህንነት ስልጠና ጥያቄዎች አሉዎት? የቴክኒክ ድጋፍ ይፈልጋሉ? ወይስ አጠራጣሪ እንቅስቃሴን ሪፖርት ማድረግ ይፈልጋሉ? ቡድናችን እርስዎን ለማገዝ ዝግጁ ነው።
common.sendMessageDesc: እባክዎ ከታች ያለውን ቅጽ ይሙሉ። ብዙ ጊዜ በ1 የስራ ቀን ውስጥ ምላሽ እንሰጣለን።
common.messagePlaceholder: እንዴት ልንረዳዎ እንችላለን? እባክዎ እንደ የይለፍ ቃል ያሉ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን አያካትቱ።
common.privacyConsent: ይህ ድረ-ገጽ ምላሽ ለመስጠት እንዲችል ያቀረብኩትን መረጃ እንዲያከማች ተስማምቻለሁ። <privacyLink>የግላዊነት ፖሊሲ</privacyLink> ይመልከቱ።
common.cantFindTitle: Can't find what you're looking for?
common.cantFindDescSupport: Our dedicated cyber intelligence support experts are available 24/7 to assist citizens and organizations with specific security challenges.

landing.heroSubtitle: ዜጎችን፣ ንግዶችን እና ተቋማትን ከሳይበር አደጋዎች ለመከላከል እውቀት የሚሰጥ ኦፊሴላዊ የመንግስት መድረክ።
landing.strategicPillarsDesc: ለሁሉም ዜጎች እና ድርጅቶች አስተማማኝ ዲጂታል አካባቢ ለማረጋገጥ ያለንን ብሔራዊ ቁርጠኝነት የሚገልጹ መሪ መርሆች።
landing.pillar1Desc: ሁሉንም ዜጎች እና ድርጅቶች በይነተገናኝ ሞዱሎች አማካኝነት አስፈላጊ የሳይበር ደህንነት ክህሎቶችን ማስታጠቅ።
landing.pillar2Desc: ስለ ንቁ የማስገር እና የራንሰምዌር ዘመቻዎች ወቅታዊ እና አስተማማኝ ማንቂያዎችን መስጠት።
landing.pillar3Desc: ለሁሉም ዘርፎች ጠንካራ ዲጂታል መከላከያዎችን ለማቋቋም ተግባራዊ መመሪያ እና መሳሪያዎችን ማቅረብ።
landing.tailoredGuidanceDesc: የሳይበር ስጋቶች ሲያቋርጡ አያቆሙም። ለዘርፍዎ ፍላጎቶች የተዘጋጁ ልዩ መረጃዎችን፣ ማዕቀፎችን እና ተግባራዊ ምክሮችን ያግኙ።
landing.incidentPlaybooksDesc: በአካባቢዎ ውስጥ ንቁ ስጋቶችን ለመያዝ እና ለማጥፋት ደረጃ በደረጃ መመሪያዎች።
landing.complianceFrameworksDesc: ለISO 27001፣ NIST CSF እና ብሔራዊ የሳይበር ደህንነት ትዕዛዞች የተቀረጹ መቆጣጠሪያዎች።
landing.threatModelingDesc: ከማሰማራቱ በፊት የስነ-ህንጻ ተጋላጭነቶችን ለመለየት ደረጃቸውን የጠበቁ ሰነዶች።
landing.securityKitsDesc: ለውስጣዊ ዘመቻዎች የሚታተሙ ፖስተሮች፣ የኢሜይል አብነቶች እና የአቀራረብ ስላይዶች።
landing.alertRansomwareDesc: የተቀናጀ የራንሰምዌር ጥቃት ብሔራዊ መሠረተ ልማት ላይ ኢላማ እያደረገ ነው። ሁሉም ሲስተሞች የተጠገኑ እና ከመስመር ውጭ ምትኬዎች ወዲያውኑ የተጠበቁ መሆናቸውን ያረጋግጡ።
landing.alertPhishingDesc: የሳይበር ወንጀለኞች የግብር ባለስልጣንን የሚመስሉ የማጭበርበር ኢሜይሎችን እየላኩ ነው። ከማያውቋቸው ላኪዎች ሊንኮችን አይጫኑ ወይም የውሂብ ማስያዣዎችን አያውርዱ።
landing.alertBrowserPatchDesc: ዋና ዋና የአሳሽ አቅራቢዎች በማቅረቢያ ሞተሮች ውስጥ የዜሮ-ቀን ተጋላጭነትን ለመፍታት ወሳኝ ዝማኔዎችን ለቀዋል። እባክዎ ወዲያውኑ ያዘምኑ።
landing.ctaDesc: ሳይበር ደህንነት የጋራ ኃላፊነት ነው። ስጋቶችን ለመለየት እና የብሔራችንን ዲጂታል የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ለመጠበቅ በሚረዱ እውቀቶች እራስዎን ያስታጥቁ።
landing.aboutDesc: ብሔራዊ የሳይበር ደህንነት ግንዛቤ ፖርታል ጠንካራ፣ አስተማማኝ እና መረጃ ያለው ዲጂታል ማህበረሰብ ለመገንባት የተቋቋመ ማዕከላዊ ባለስልጣን ነው። በንቃት ትምህርት፣ የስጋት መረጃ መጋራት እና የህዝብ-የግል ሽርክናዎች አማካኝነት እያንዳንዱ ዜጋ ከሳይበር ስጋቶች እንዲከላከል እናበረታታለን።
landing.coreMissionDesc1: የሳይበር ማስፈራሪያዎች አይቆሙም። እኛም እንዲሁ። ዋነኛ ዓላማችን ኢንተርኔት ፈጠራ የሚያብብበት እና መረጃ የሚጠበቅበት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ አካባቢ ሆኖ እንዲቀጥል ማድረግ ነው።
landing.coreMissionDesc2: በትምህርት፣ ስጋቶችን በመጋራት እና በህዝብና የግል አጋርነት ለእያንዳንዱ ዜጋ ዲጂታል መከላከያ እየገነባን ነው።
landing.proactiveDefenseDesc: በተጠቃሚዎች ላይ ተጽዕኖ ከማሳደራቸው በፊት ስጋቶችን የመለየት እና የማምከን አቅምን ማዳበር።
landing.nationalEducationDesc: ለትምህርት ቤቶች፣ ንግዶች እና መንግስት የሳይበር ደህንነት ስርአተ ትምህርትን መዘርጋት።
landing.unifiedResponseDesc: በመንግስት እና በግል ዘርፎች ፈጣን የክስተት ምላሽ ሞዴሎችን ማስተባበር።
landing.whoWeServeDesc: የሳይበር ደህንነት የሁሉም ሰው ኃላፊነት ነው።
landing.citizensFamiliesDesc: መሳሪያዎችን ስለመጠበቅ እና በመስመር ላይ ህጻናትን ስለመጠበቅ ግልጽ መመሪያ።
landing.smallBusinessesDesc: ትልቅ የአይቲ በጀት ሳያስፈልግ የደንበኞችን መረጃ ለመጠበቅ የሚያስችል አሰራር።
landing.governmentAgenciesDesc: ለሀገራዊ መሠረተ ልማት የብዝሃ-ደረጃ የመከላከያ ስልቶች።
landing.ctaReadyTitle: ዲጂታል ህይወትዎን ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ለማድረግ ዝግጁ ነዎት?
landing.ctaReadyDesc: በመስመር ላይ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ባህሪን ለመለማመድ ቃል የገቡትን ዜጎች ይቀላቀሉ።

courses.heroSubtitle: ስጋቶችን ለመለየት እና ዲጂታል አገራችንን ለመጠበቅ የሚያስችል ክህሎት እንዲኖርዎት በባለሙያዎች የተዘጋጀ ስልጠና።

awareness.heroSubtitle: እራስዎን እና ድርጅትዎን ከተለመዱ የሳይበር ስጋቶች ለመጠበቅ ተግባራዊ መመሪያዎችን ያስሱ።
awareness.ctaDescription: ስለ {topic} ያለዎትን ግንዛቤ ለመገምገም እና መሻሻል ያለባቸውን ቦታዎች ለመለየት የራስ-ግምገማ መሣሪያችንን ይውሰዱ።

tools.proTip: ጠቃሚ ምክር፡ ጥርጣሬ ካለዎት፣ መድረሻውን ለማየት ሳይጫኑ ማገናኛዎች ላይ ያንዣብቡ።
tools.passwordDesc: ጠንካራ የይለፍ ቃላት የመጀመሪያ የመከላከያ መስመርዎ ናቸው።

awarenessData.phishingProtectionDesc: Learn to identify and avoid phishing attempts that target your personal and professional information through deceptive emails, messages, and websites.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Desc: Recognize the common signs of phishing emails before you click.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul1: Check sender addresses for misspellings or odd domains
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul2: Hover over links before clicking to preview the destination
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul3: Watch for urgent language demanding immediate action
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec1Bul4: Be wary of unsolicited attachments or download prompts
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Desc: Build habits that protect you from malicious links wherever they appear.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul1: Navigate directly to websites rather than using email links
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul2: Verify shortened URLs before visiting them
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul3: Look for HTTPS and correct domain names in the address bar
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec2Bul4: Use link scanners on suspicious URLs before opening
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Desc: Know how and where to report phishing attempts to protect yourself and others.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul1: Forward suspicious emails to your security team or report@cybersafenation.gov
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul2: Use built-in phishing reporting tools in your email client
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul3: Report smishing (SMS phishing) to your mobile provider
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec3Bul4: Document and report any credentials you may have accidentally disclosed
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Desc: Add an extra layer of security to your accounts beyond just a password.
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul1: Enable 2FA on all accounts that support it
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul2: Prefer authenticator apps over SMS-based codes
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul3: Use hardware security keys for critical accounts
awarenessData.phishingProtectionSec4Bul4: Never share your 2FA codes with anyone, even if they ask
awarenessData.passwordHygieneDesc: Master the fundamentals of strong password practices to keep your accounts secure from breaches and unauthorized access.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Desc: Create passwords that are easy to remember but hard to crack.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul1: Use at least 12-16 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul2: Avoid dictionary words, personal info, or common patterns
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul3: Create passphrases from random word combinations
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec1Bul4: Never reuse passwords across multiple accounts
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Desc: Let a password manager generate and store complex passwords for you.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul1: Choose a reputable password manager with strong encryption
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul2: Use auto-fill features to avoid typing credentials manually
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul3: Enable biometric unlock for your password vault
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec2Bul4: Regularly audit your vault for weak or reused passwords
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Desc: Combine passwords with additional verification methods for stronger security.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul1: Layer MFA on top of strong passwords for critical accounts
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul2: Understand the difference between 2FA and MFA
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul3: Use backup codes in case you lose access to your MFA device
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec3Bul4: Periodically review which accounts have MFA enabled
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Desc: Know when and how often to change your passwords for optimal security.
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul1: Change passwords immediately after a known or suspected breach
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul2: Rotate shared or service account passwords quarterly
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul3: Avoid changing passwords too frequently unless required
awarenessData.passwordHygieneSec4Bul4: Use the password checker tool to test your password strength
awarenessData.secureBrowsingDesc: Adopt safe browsing habits and configure your browser to protect your privacy and security while navigating the web.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Desc: Ensure your connections are encrypted and your data stays private.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul1: Always look for the padlock icon and HTTPS in the address bar
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul2: Avoid entering sensitive data on pages without HTTPS
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul3: Use browser extensions that force HTTPS connections
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec1Bul4: Be cautious when using public Wi-Fi without a VPN
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Desc: Configure your browser for maximum security without breaking functionality.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul1: Keep your browser updated to the latest version
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul2: Enable pop-up blocking and automatic security checks
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec2Bul3: Review and restrict site permissions (location, camera, microphone)
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Desc: Recognize and steer clear of websites designed to compromise your security.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul1: Use search results cautiously — ads can lead to malicious sites
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul2: Check for poor grammar, design quality, or unusual URLs
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul3: Avoid downloading software from unverified sources
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec3Bul4: Use safe browsing tools provided by major browsers
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Desc: Stay secure when connecting to networks outside your home or office.
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul1: Avoid accessing sensitive accounts on public Wi-Fi
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul2: Use a VPN to encrypt your traffic on untrusted networks
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul3: Turn off file sharing and AirDrop when in public
awarenessData.secureBrowsingSec4Bul4: Forget the network after use to prevent auto-reconnection
awarenessData.dataPrivacyDesc: Take control of your personal information online and understand how to protect your digital footprint from unwanted exposure.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Desc: Guard your personally identifiable information (PII) from exposure.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul1: Limit the personal information you share on public profiles
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul2: Use aliases or email aliases for non-essential services
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul3: Never share your national ID, SSN, or passport details online
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec1Bul4: Shred physical documents containing personal information
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Desc: Manage what you share and who can see it on social platforms.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul1: Review privacy settings on all social media accounts
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul2: Limit past posts visibility to friends or trusted contacts
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul3: Disable location tagging on posts and photos
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec2Bul4: Be selective about accepting connection requests
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Desc: Understand how your data is collected and used by services you interact with.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul1: Read privacy policies before signing up for new services
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul2: Opt out of data collection where options are available
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul3: Review app permissions regularly and revoke unnecessary access
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec3Bul4: Understand the difference between free services and data monetization
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Desc: Configure tools and platforms to minimize your digital exposure.
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul1: Use private or incognito browsing for sensitive searches
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul2: Enable Do Not Track and tracker blocking in your browser
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul3: Use search engines that don't track your history
awarenessData.dataPrivacySec4Bul4: Regularly audit third-party access to your accounts
awarenessData.incidentResponseDesc: Know exactly what steps to take when you suspect a security breach, compromised account, or cyber incident.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Desc: Recognize the signs that your account or device may be compromised.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul1: Look for unexpected password reset emails or 2FA prompts
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul2: Check for unrecognized logins in your account activity logs
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul3: Watch for unusual device behavior like slow performance or pop-ups
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec1Bul4: Monitor for unauthorized transactions or changes to your accounts
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Desc: Take immediate action to prevent further damage.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul1: Disconnect the affected device from the internet immediately
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul2: Change passwords for compromised accounts from a clean device
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul3: Enable or re-enable 2FA on any accounts that were accessed
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec2Bul4: Remove unknown devices from your trusted device list
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Desc: Notify the right people and authorities about the incident.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul1: Report the incident to your organization's IT security team
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul2: Contact your bank or financial institutions if financial data is involved
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul3: File a report with local law enforcement or cyber crime unit
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec3Bul4: Report phishing or scams to relevant national reporting centers
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Desc: Restore your systems and prevent future incidents.
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul1: Run full antivirus and anti-malware scans on affected devices
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul2: Restore data from clean, verified backups
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul3: Review and tighten all security settings across accounts
awarenessData.incidentResponseSec4Bul4: Document the incident and lessons learned for future prevention
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsDesc: Build a strong foundation of everyday security practices that protect you from the most common cyber threats.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Desc: Keep your devices and applications up to date to patch known vulnerabilities.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul1: Enable automatic updates for your operating system and apps
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul2: Restart devices promptly after updates are installed
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul3: Don't delay security patches — they fix active vulnerabilities
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec1Bul4: Remove outdated software that no longer receives updates
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Desc: Use reliable security software to detect and block malware.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul1: Install reputable antivirus software on all devices
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec2Bul2: Keep virus definitions updated for the latest threat detection
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Desc: Protect your data with a reliable backup plan so you never lose what matters.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul1: Follow the 3-2-1 rule: 3 copies, 2 media types, 1 off-site
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul2: Automate regular backups so you don't have to remember
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul3: Test your backups periodically to ensure they can be restored
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec3Bul4: Encrypt backup files for sensitive data
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Desc: Secure physical access to your devices at all times.
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul1: Use strong PINs, passwords, or biometric locks on all devices
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul2: Configure auto-lock after a short period of inactivity
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul3: Enable remote wipe capabilities for lost or stolen devices
awarenessData.cyberHygieneBasicsSec4Bul4: Never leave devices unattended in public or shared spaces
